label: input h at original positions 2-3 after particular prefixes (first token k/y/r/a/t, previous token i/h/n/x/0/v/l)
explanation: Very sparse unit (about 0.03% of steps). It fires only in the original phase and almost only at t=2 (75% of mass) or t=3 (24%). Never at t<2, on the delimiter, or in the copy phase. The input is h on 86% of mass, with u and v making up most of the rest. Which h steps fire depends on the specific prefix: the first token being k, y or r gives 4-8x lift, and the previous token being i, h or n gives about 10x. The largest activations are k..i,h (k w i h, k i h, k e h h), and an h right after another h also fires. Input h at t=2-3 alone gets recall 0.81 but precision 0.05, so the unit encodes a narrow prefix conjunction, not the token h by itself. The prefix-list predicate is a partial lookup table (dev F1 about 0.49, mass recall 0.60). It misses the u/v cases (e.g. k i u) and h after v or 0.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=k (+3.78), prev_tok=i (+3.52), t=2 & prev_tok=h (+2.93), t=2 & in_tok=h (+2.91), prev2_tok=y (+2.64), orig0=r (+2.24). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-1.78), in_count=1 (-0.80).
